title: perilla ocymoides
intro: Perilla ocymoides, commonly known as wild perilla or Korean perilla, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Perilla ocymodes include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Perilla ocymoides include perillaldehyde, limonene, and beta-sitosterol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
